title: OtpInput
summary: Typing a digit now fades and grows it into its slot (180ms) instead of appearing, and when a code is rejected the slots turn red and shake sideways once (4px, 3 cycles, 300ms). Reduced motion keeps the red border and skips the shake and the grow. Slot size (54 x 60), the 24px gap and all keyboard behaviour are unchanged.
why: Apple's one-time-code fields and shadcn/input-otp (via Vercel's examples) shake the row on a wrong code, the clearest non-colour error cue; the red border alone is easy to miss.
A digit that eases in confirms each keypress without adding a cursor animation.

scenarioLabels.type-digit: Typing 7 (frame samples: colour alpha 0 to 1, font size 14.4 to 16px)
scenarioLabels.error-feedback: New story: verify a wrong code (frame samples: row x offset)

motion.after: Digit colour alpha 0 to 1 and size 14.4 to 16px over 180ms, --v2-ease-spring (sampled critically damped spring; Figma: Gentle spring or bezier 0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). The digit is the input's own text, so 'scale .9 to 1' is a font-size change; slot size is untouched
Red border (150ms, unchanged) plus the slot row shakes: translateX 0, -4, +4, -4, +4, -4, +4, 0 px at equal steps over 300ms ease-in-out (3 full cycles), measured -3.95 to +3.95px, back to 0
No shake, no size change; the digit still fades in (180ms); border colour unchanged

states: Slot / empty: text colour transparent, caret --v2-text-secondary #5E5E5E (visible)
Row / error: slots border --semantic-error-primary #F04438; row translateX keyframes (animation only)
figmaSteps: Slot: 54 x 60, radius 8px, gap between slots 24px, digit Inter 16px #5E5E5E (unchanged).
Add the digit enter as an interaction: empty slot variant (no digit) to filled variant, Smart Animate 180ms Gentle spring; digit layer opacity 0% to 100% and scale 90% to 100%.

Add an 'Error / shake' prototype on the slot row frame: five Smart Animate steps x offset 0, -4, +4, -4, +4, -4, +4, 0 px, total 300ms, ease in-out. Border --semantic-error-primary #F04438 on all slots.
Annotate reduced motion: no shake, no scale; digits fade only.
notes: The shake runs when `error` turns on after the first render; an error that is already showing on load does not shake, and a second wrong attempt only shakes again if the app turns error off and on.
The empty slot's text is transparent with an explicit caret colour so the caret stays visible; digits keep selecting on focus as before.
A new story 'Error feedback' (Verify a wrong code) demonstrates the shake; OtpInput has no v1 so there is no contract to compare.
